name: Skills MCP
headline: Skills MCP: Reusable Agent Skills via MCP
short_description: An MCP server that brings Claude's Skills pattern to any MCP-compatible agent, letting you create modular, reusable skills once and deploy them across Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and more.
author: skills-mcp

sections.overview:
Skills MCP is an MCP server inspired by Claude's Skills format that lets you define modular, reusable skills in a directory and expose them automatically to any MCP-compatible agent. By pointing the server at a skills folder, agents like Claude Code, Claude for Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code can discover and use those skills without redundant configuration. The core value proposition is write-once, use-everywhere: a single skills directory works across all supported tools. Setup is handled via npx with no global install required, and configuration is done through each tool's standard MCP JSON config file. This approach helps developers and teams maintain consistent agent behavior and domain expertise across multiple AI coding environments.
Sharing a library of custom agent skills across Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code without duplication
Giving an AI agent domain-specific expertise by pointing it at a curated skills directory
Standardizing agent behavior across a development team using a shared skills folder
Quickly bootstrapping MCP skill support in a new project using a single npx command
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/skills-mcp/skills-mcp`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an MCP-compatible agent with the following skills: [SKILL1], [SKILL2], [SKILL3]. Use these skills to accomplish [TASK] for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Provide a step-by-step plan and execute each step using the specified skills.
```
Copy

```
# Task Execution Plan for GreenTech Solutions
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
